tasks.short: Check completed work and file the accepted check.

steps.what: Ensure the completed work was performed properly.

tasks.design: The broker checks the work the officers, the attorneys, and the other professionals completed, and ensures it was performed properly. {DOCS} opens the file and files the check they accepted. Nothing decides that the work was proper.
tasks.previous_blocker: The file was read twice because the check was not on it.
tasks.enabler_now: A completed file can be opened before the broker checks it.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the work was performed properly stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker checks. An opened file does not.
tasks.altitude: The check stays in full. Only opening the file and filing the accepted check are shorter.

reach.task: See the check the broker accepted
reach.learn: The broker still decides if the work was proper

evidence.claim: Opening a file another profession completed, and filing a check the broker accepted, does not review the work. The broker does.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when another profession has completed work on the file and ends when the accepted check is filed. The broker checks it.

The fields are the profession, the document name, and the broker's result proper or not. The other profession produces the document. The broker produces the result. If a document is missing, the check says so and is not filed as proper.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the check stays.
unknowns: Which documents the office expects from the attorney before closing.
Whether a loan officer's file is already in the record.
research_questions: Which documents does the office expect from the attorney before closing?
Is a loan officer's file already in the record?

tasks.short: Appraise property values and file the accepted ones.

steps.what: Pull recent sales for the property.
Start assessing income potential where relevant.

tasks.design: The broker assesses income potential where it is relevant and appraises the property values. {CRM} only pulls recent sales. A tested model value may sit beside the table and is not the appraisal. The broker accepts the values. {DOCS} files that version. A forecast is not the appraisal. The value is not for a lender to treat as a loan decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales were gathered before the broker could appraise.
tasks.enabler_now: Recent sales can be listed beside the property.
tasks.still_hard: The appraisal stays with the broker. A model does not finish it.
tasks.human_edge: The broker appraises. A table does not.
tasks.altitude: Assessing income and appraising the values stay in full. Only the pull of sales and the filing of the accepted values are shorter.

reach.learn: The lender still decides the loan

evidence.claim: Calcasa Model Waardering produces an automated value tested against sale prices. It is not for mortgage lending. It does not set the price the broker will say.
Zillow stopped buying homes in November 2021 after an inventory write-down it blamed on price forecasts. A forecast is not the price the broker will say.

A house valuation is not credit scoring. A bot must say it is a machine. An edited photo of a real home must be labelled. Staff who use such tools need literacy. This design has no bot and does not edit photos.
Estate agents, rental brokers from EUR 10,000 a month, and appraisers are institutions under anti-money-laundering rules. Citing the rule does not satisfy it. The broker sets the risk.
National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a value is needed and ends when the accepted values are on file. The broker appraises. The model does not finish it.

The fields are sale price, sale date, and income where the broker marks it relevant. The sale record produces the sales. The broker produces the value. A model figure is not copied into the value field.
The prior classes this task as amplify. The steps agree the appraisal stays.
unknowns: Whether income is relevant for this property.
Whether the office already holds a tested model value beside the sales.
research_questions: Is income relevant for this property?
Does the office already hold a tested model value beside the sales?

tasks.short: Arrange financing and send the accepted request.

steps.what: Arrange financing for the property purchases.
Read the lender reply on the purchases.

tasks.design: The broker arranges the financing and reads the lender's reply. {DOCS} lists the documents the purchase needs. They accept the request. {EMAIL} sends that version. The lender determines eligibility. The broker does not.
tasks.previous_blocker: The document list was rebuilt for each lender.
tasks.enabler_now: A purchase can hold the document names the lender asked for last time.
tasks.still_hard: What the buyer should hear about the reply stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker arranges. A list does not obtain the financing.
tasks.altitude: Arranging the financing and reading the reply stay in full. Only the document list and the send of the accepted request are shorter.

reach.task: Receive a request the broker accepted

evidence.claim: National rules differ on who may advise a buyer about a price or a mortgage. A system does not give that advice here. The broker does.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.
Recording calls, or analysing speech in a way that can monitor staff, needs works-council consent. This design does not record a call or a seminar and does not score the broker.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a purchase needs financing and ends when the accepted request is with the lender. The broker arranges it. Calls are not recorded. The lender determines eligibility.
The fields are property id, purchase price, lender name, and document names. The broker assembles them. The lender produces the reply. If a document is missing, the request is not sent.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the arranging stays.

tasks.short: Review environmental regulations for the property.

steps.what: Read property details on the record.
Review environmental regulations for the property.
Ensure the property details meet them.

tasks.design: The broker reviews the regulations and ensures the property details meet them. {DOCS} only opens the details already on the record. Nothing decides that a regulation is met.
tasks.previous_blocker: The details were printed before the broker could review them.
tasks.enabler_now: Details already on the record can be opened.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a regulation is met stays with the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker reviews. An opened record does not.
tasks.altitude: The review stays in full. Only opening the stored details is shorter.

reach.learn: The broker still decides if a regulation is met

evidence.claim: Opening stored property details does not decide that an environmental regulation is met. The broker reviews that.
Identity and financial details of an owner or a buyer are personal data. They leave the office only in a version the broker has accepted.

assumptions: The workflow starts when property details must be checked against environmental regulations and ends when the broker has noted the review. Nothing is sent.
The fields are the detail name and the regulation name. The record produces the detail. The broker produces the result met or not. If a detail is missing, the note says so.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the review stays.
